title: Use the global virtual-field primitive rather than assuming a stream function
statement: Planar div w=Delta w=0 makes curl constant and gives W=i alpha z+conjugate(g(z)) with globally single-valued holomorphic g. Closed-component traction integrates an exact dg and constant pressure, hence zero resultant force even around holes. Energy then forces zero field for zero outer and purely translating inner traces. An abstract holomorphic tensor need not have this attainable virtual-field primitive.
